signals.signal: MCP authorization and transport contracts changed materially in the 2026-07-28 specification release, while official free conformance tooling already exists.
signals.implication: Only cross-client release evidence may remain; reject a generic MCP tester.

signals.signal: Entra, Google, AWS and Okta now ship agent identity, registry, authorization, evaluation or revocation controls.
signals.implication: Reject broad agent IAM/governance; investigate only declared-permission versus observed-outcome reconciliation.

signals.signal: Microsoft reports computer-use success around 80% for web and 35% for desktop tasks and tells users to verify AI-authored Excel work.
signals.implication: Deterministic last-mile outcome and workbook release assertions remain plausible.

signals.signal: Shopify automatically publishes eligible products to AI channels and generates agents.md; UCP/AP2/ACP and payment-network rails are developing quickly.
signals.implication: Reject generic agent-commerce readiness; test B2B entitlement leakage and transaction exceptions only.

signals.signal: AWS SLA claims require timely customer-filed cases, incident intervals, corroborating logs and complete information.
signals.implication: Multi-provider SLA credit recovery has a real evidence-reconciliation object, but dollar magnitude is unproven.

signals.signal: PPWR applies from 12 August 2026 and creates packaging-information and conformity obligations; SAP already covers broad compliance data management.
signals.implication: Test a narrow release preflight, not another PPWR system of record.

signals.signal: CRA reporting obligations begin 11 September 2026 with early-warning and notification workflows through ENISA infrastructure.
signals.implication: Version-to-vulnerability-to-submission rehearsal is time-bounded and testable.

signals.signal: Four EUDAMED modules became mandatory on 28 May 2026 and official UI, XML upload and M2M paths coexist.
signals.implication: Submission rejection and published-state reconciliation are viable narrow objects; reject a portal clone.

signals.signal: EU battery-passport duties begin 18 February 2027 while Catena-X and Eclipse Tractus-X provide ecosystem and open-source infrastructure.
signals.implication: Lifecycle delta testing is too early; reject a generic passport registry.

signals.signal: CBAM entered its definitive regime on 1 January 2026 with registry, emissions and certificate-price workflows.
signals.implication: Reconcile shipment, embedded emissions, certificates and finance; suite absorption remains a major risk.

signals.signal: iLab, PPMS and Science Exchange already span laboratory request, usage, billing and outsourced-R&D invoice workflows.
signals.implication: Reject broad lab operations and R&D procurement products.

signals.signal: The canonical corpus already contains close analogues for the strongest external signals and the staging queue contains the 2026 regulatory variants.
signals.implication: Prefer MERGE/RESEARCH_MORE decisions; this run does not add another duplicate candidate.
